text:
{
  "intents": [
    {
      "name": "live_disruption_status",
      "definition": "Customer asks for real‑time information about a specific train’s delay, cancellation, driver absence or platform, or wants to know if a service is running now.",
      "includes": [
        "inquire_train_delay",
        "request_service_status",
        "inquire_morning_service_status",
        "check_service_status",
        "request_current_delay_status",
        "driver_absence_delay",
        "request_platform_information"
      ],
      "excludes": [
        "request_compensation_for_late_arrival",
        "inquire_delay_and_compensation",
        "request_delay_information",
        "request_delay_info_and_compensation"
      ],
      "hard_case": "“The 08:02 from Maidenhead is always late, why?” – This is a punctuality explanation (historical pattern) not a live status request, so it belongs to punctuality_explanation.",
      "needs_live_data": true,
      "default_disposition": "assist",
      "disposition_rationale": "Answers require up‑to‑date running data that the bot cannot guarantee; a human should verify before replying.",
      "source_clusters": ["24","5","29","15","31","0","26"],
      "est_share": 12.5
    },
    {
      "name": "punctuality_explanation",
      "definition": "Customer seeks an explanation for recurring lateness or systematic delay of a service, not a current status.",
      "includes": [
        "request_punctuality_explanation"
      ],
      "excludes": [
        "live_disruption_status",
        "request_compensation_for_late_arrival"
      ],
      "hard_case": "“Hi, what time will the delayed 07:53 TWY‑PAD get to PAD?” – This asks for the current expected arrival, so it belongs to live_disruption_status.",
      "needs_live_data": false,
      "default_disposition": "auto",
      "disposition_rationale": "A standard template explaining typical causes of lateness can be safely sent.",
      "source_clusters": ["16"],
      "est_share": 3.1
    },
    {
      "name": "ticket_purchase_and_booking",
      "definition": "Customer needs help buying, printing, refunding, or troubleshooting tickets on the website/app, including season tickets and advance releases.",
      "includes": [
        "ticket_purchase_assistance",
        "website_booking_issue",
        "inquire_advance_ticket_release"
      ],
      "excludes": [
        "request_seat_reservation",
        "request_cancellation_info_and_refund"
      ],
      "hard_case": "“Can I reserve a seat on the 09:15 to Bristol?” – This is a seat reservation request, not a purchase issue, so it belongs to seat_reservation.",
      "needs_live_data": false,
      "default_disposition": "assist",
      "disposition_rationale": "May require checking account or availability; a human drafts the response.",
      "source_clusters": ["17","14","10"],
      "est_share": 9.3
    },
    {
      "name": "seat_reservation",
      "definition": "Customer asks to reserve, confirm, change or query a seat reservation on a specific service.",
      "includes": [
        "request_seat_reservation"
      ],
      "excludes": [
        "ticket_purchase_and_booking",
        "request_more_seating_capacity"
      ],
      "hard_case": "“Why is my train so crowded today?” – This is a capacity complaint, not a reservation query, so it belongs to capacity_requests.",
      "needs_live_data": true,
      "default_disposition": "assist",
      "disposition_rationale": "Needs to check reservation system; human assistance required.",
      "source_clusters": ["4"],
      "est_share": 2.4
    },
    {
      "name": "capacity_and_overcrowding",
      "definition": "Customer complains about overcrowding, lack of carriages or seats and requests additional capacity or fewer passengers.",
      "includes": [
        "request_additional_carriages",
        "request_more_capacity",
        "request_more_seating_capacity",
        "request_more_capacity"
      ],
      "excludes": [
        "seat_reservation",
        "live_disruption_status"
      ],
      "hard_case": "“Can you add another carriage to the 06:32 Didcot‑Paddington?” – This is a request for extra carriages (capacity), not a seat reservation.",
      "needs_live_data": true,
      "default_disposition": "assist",
      "disposition_rationale": "Operational changes need human approval.",
      "source_clusters": ["21","19","25","12"],
      "est_share": 7.5
    },
    {
      "name": "compensation_and_refunds",
      "definition": "Customer seeks monetary compensation, refund or claim status for a past delay, cancellation or poor service.",
      "includes": [
        "request_compensation_for_late_arrival",
        "inquire_delay_and_compensation",
        "request_delay_info_and_compensation",
        "request_cancellation_info_and_refund",
        "request_complaint_update",
        "demand_compensation_for_poor_service"
      ],
      "excludes": [
        "live_disruption_status",
        "punctuality_explanation"
      ],
      "hard_case": "“Why was the 17:06 Pad‑Westbury cancelled?” – This asks for the reason, not compensation, so it belongs to live_disruption_status.",
      "needs_live_data": false,
      "default_disposition": "assist",
      "disposition_rationale": "Compensation requires policy checks and possibly account data.",
      "source_clusters": ["7","8","11","13","27","22"],
      "est_share": 13.5
    },
    {
      "name": "service_information_general",
      "definition": "Customer asks for static or schedule‑related information that does not need real‑time data: new train schedules, future service availability, tomorrow’s service, coach count, or general service queries.",
      "includes": [
        "inquire_new_train_schedule",
        "request_service_schedule",
        "inquire_service_tomorrow",
        "inquire_coach_count",
        "request_train_time_info"
      ],
      "excludes": [
        "live_disruption_status",
        "ticket_purchase_and_booking"
      ],
      "hard_case": "“How many coaches will the 07:33 Pang‑Paddington have today?” – If the user asks for today’s count, it needs live data and belongs to live_disruption_status; only future‑date queries stay here.",
      "needs_live_data": false,
      "default_disposition": "auto",
      "disposition_rationale": "Answers can be drawn from published timetables.",
      "source_clusters": ["6","9.5","23","28","20"],
      "est_share": 7.0
    },
    {
      "name": "onboard_service_and_facilities",
      "definition": "Customer raises issues or asks questions about onboard amenities, seating comfort, accessibility, Wi‑Fi, toilets, or staff behaviour.",
      "includes": [
        "inquire_onboard_services",
        "staff_complaint",
        "request_help"
      ],
      "excludes": [
        "capacity_and_overcrowding",
        "compensation_and_refunds"
      ],
      "hard_case": "“The Wi‑Fi was unusable, and the train kept getting later.” – This mixes a Wi‑Fi complaint with a delay; the primary intent is a live disruption status, so it belongs to live_disruption_status.",
      "needs_live_data": false,
      "default_disposition": "assist",
      "disposition_rationale": "Often needs a human to acknowledge and possibly forward to operations.",
      "source_clusters": ["9.0","9.6","30","9.2"],
      "est_share": 9.5
    },
    {
      "name": "positive_feedback",
      "definition": "Customer expresses appreciation, compliments or positive experience.",
      "includes": [
        "provide_positive_feedback"
      ],
      "excludes": [
        "negative_complaint"
      ],
      "hard_case": "“Great journey, but the train was 10 minutes late.” – The presence of a complaint pushes it to live_disruption_status.",
      "needs_live_data": false,
      "default_disposition": "auto",
      "disposition_rationale": "Can be replied with a thank‑you template.",
      "source_clusters": ["9.4"],
      "est_share": 1.8
    },
    {
      "name": "other",
      "definition": "Any message that does not fit the above intents, including spam, unrelated chatter, or ambiguous multi‑intent messages that cannot be cleanly classified.",
      "includes": [
        "multiple_intents",
        "multiple_unrelated_requests",
        "noise"
      ],
      "excludes": [],
      "hard_case": "“Can I get a replacement taxi pls?” – This is a request for a replacement bus, which belongs to replacement_bus_info; if the bot cannot recognise it, it falls here.",
      "needs_live_data": false,
      "default_disposition": "escalate",
      "disposition_rationale": "Human must decide the appropriate handling.",
      "source_clusters": ["9.3","9.1","9.2","18","1"],
      "est_share": 5.0
    }
  ],
  "merges_explained": "Clusters were merged based on identical handling pathways. All live‑status queries (delays, cancellations, driver absence, platform) became live_disruption_status. All compensation‑related clusters were grouped under compensation_and_refunds because they all require policy lookup and claim processing. Ticket purchase, website issues and advance‑ticket queries share the same support flow (guide, troubleshoot, link) and form ticket_purchase_and_booking. Capacity‑related complaints (extra carriages, overcrowding, standing‑room) were merged into capacity_and_overcrowding. Static schedule queries (new trains, future coach count, tomorrow’s service) formed service_information_general. Onboard amenity complaints and staff behaviour were combined into onboard_service_and_facilities. Positive feedback stayed separate. The catch‑all other captures multi‑intent or noisy messages.",
  "dropped": "No clusters were dropped as noise; all were assigned to an intent or the catch‑all."
}
